contentBlocks.text: SASSA pays grants on specific days each month, staggered by grant type. Permanent grants (Older Person, Disability, Children's) are paid in the first week. The SRD R370 grant is paid in batches from the 25th to the 30th. Click any month for the full schedule.

faqs.question: When are SASSA grants paid each month?
faqs.answer: Payment dates are staggered by grant type. Older Persons grants are paid first (2nd-5th), followed by Disability grants (3rd-6th), then Children's grants (4th-7th). SRD R370 is paid between the 25th and 30th.

faqs.question: Do I need to withdraw on the first day?
faqs.answer: No. Your grant remains available in your account. You can withdraw any time after the pay date. Avoiding peak queues by collecting a few days later is recommended.

faqs.question: How long does bank transfer take?
faqs.answer: Bank transfers typically reflect 1-3 business days after the official pay date. Plan accordingly.

faqs.question: What if I lose the cash send SMS?
faqs.answer: Contact SASSA at 0800 60 10 11 to request a resend. You can also visit a SASSA office with your ID for a replacement voucher.
